title: Yoisaki Kanade — Early Morning Struggles〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kanade, shouldn't you get up soon?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Mafuyu...? What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I knocked, but you didn't answer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (We're going to Ena's dad's exhibit today...!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry! I'll get up now...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Did you stay up all night working again...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-Yes. I was trying to find a good place to stop, but I sort of lost track of time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
Just give me a second to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry about making you help me get ready. I didn't realize my hair was such a mess...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. I'm just glad we were able to fix it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You did all the work, Mafuyu.
I can't really see the back of my head, so thank you for straightening it all out.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We ended up leaving the house a little late, but I'm glad that it looks like we'll still be able to meet up with Mizuki on time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm guessing it worked out since we planned to get there a bit early.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I had to get ready in a hurry.
I hope I didn't forget to bring anything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You should be fine as long as you have the essentials, like your phone and wallet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Good point.
Let's see... My phone and wallet are...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I remember being a little surprised when I first heard that her dad's a famous artist. I mean, I immediately recognized his name...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have you ever seen any of his works before, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Just a few.
My mom's a fan of his.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She doesn't seem too bothered by that...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We need to take a right up here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Ena also stayed up late working last night. I hope she was able to get up this morning.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I just hope she didn't oversleep like you did, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, it's been so long since I last went to an art exhibit. And this one's by Ena's dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to it.
